claims.assertion: Mari says limited memory, including of past lives, makes populations easier to steer toward new social narratives.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She links this to Earth's veil of forgetting.

claims.assertion: Mari defines a soft reset as gradual manipulation of perception and values across generations, unlike a hard reset caused by catastrophe.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says soft resets take one or two generations.

claims.assertion: Mari claims the Galactic Federation controls Earth and directs sociocultural trends toward repeated soft resets.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She estimates a complete reset takes about 150 years and says controllers live off-planet.
